claim: A blocking resume of an agent that is still running - Agent({resume:<id>, run_in_background:false}) - is not refused. It returns pi's internal error text, flips the live agent's record to status error (hasRunning() goes false, steer_subagent refuses, stop/abortAll skip it), and a follow-up get_subagent_result marks it consumed, so the real answer that lands seconds later is never notified. The default (background) resume path guards exactly this case; the foreground path does not.
evidence: cmd: cd probes/agents && ./RUN.sh p05-resume-and-mention.probe.test.ts -t R1 -> out/p05-r1-blocking-resume-of-running-agent.json: reply `Agent failed: Agent is already processing. Specify streamingBehavior ('steer' or 'followUp') to queue the message.` (isError:false); record right after, original run still in flight: {status:"error", completedAt:true}, manager.hasRunning()=false; steer_subagent -> `Agent "…" is not running (status: error). Cannot steer a non-running agent.`; get_subagent_result -> `Status: error … Error: Agent is already processing…`; 3.5 s later the record is {status:"completed", result:"CHILD_FINAL_ANSWER", error:<stale text>, resultConsumed:true} and the parent received zero subagent-notification messages. Code: the running/queued refusal exists only inside `if (runInBackground)` src/index.ts:2132-2144; the foreground branch calls manager.resume directly src/index.ts:2168 -> src/agent-manager.ts:1190-1231; abort()/abortAll() act only on status running src/agent-manager.ts:1442, :1543. SUPPORTED, not reproduced: the failed resume also aborts the live run's nested children (src/agent-manager.ts:1229) and the nested Agent tool has the same unguarded call (src/nested-tools.ts:189). Guarded contrast: out/p13-background-resume-refusal.json.
cost: Orchestrating LLM and operator. Backgrounds are the default, so the agent a model wants to 'resume and wait for' is usually still running; each such call leaves a live run that cannot be steered or stopped and whose result can be lost.
cureHint: Hoist the running/queued refusal (src/index.ts:2139-2144) above the runInBackground branch and make AgentManager.resume() refuse running/queued records on the foreground path too (covers the nested tool).

cureHint: Make the preview budget a setting with a larger default (deliver the full result up to a few KB), accept several ids in one get_subagent_result call, add type and handle to the notification, and drop the duplicate path.

cureHint: Warn on a missing or rejected skill (notify plus a reply line, with distinct wording for symlinks), head the block with the skill's directory, strip the frontmatter, and offer an index-only preload mode.

(2) the same error at `get ui` <- src/index.ts:1202:15. Code: src/agent-manager.ts:994-998 (onComplete is guarded on the success path only), src/index.ts:1186-1207 (no terminal catch, and the catch block calls ctx.ui.notify). cureHint: Guard onComplete on the error path as on the success path, end the clone chain with a catch that touches nothing on ctx, and check the session is still active before emit or notify.
